country: # Hand-curated list of well-known kite spots (WhereToKite).
# Coordinates are never typed here. `locate` is one of:
# `water`: sea | lagoon | lake. sea -> orientation from natural=coastline;
#   lagoon/lake -> from the nearest natural=water polygon (fallback coastline).
#   a sanity check and to pick the right shore on sandbars/isthmuses; the
#   published seaFacingDeg is always computed from OSM geometry.
#   Spots kitable from several shores list one side per direction
#   (the first side's water must be the row's). Each hour is then scored on the
#   side where the wind works best.

name: Le Crotoy
notes: Tidal bay: rideable around high tide only.

name: Cherrueix
notes: Bay of Mont-Saint-Michel: huge tidal range; ride around high tide.

name: Le Conquet – Blancs Sablons
locate: q:Plage des Blancs Sablons Le Conquet

name: Penthièvre
notes: Bay side of the Penthièvre isthmus (flat water); the ocean side faces W.

name: La Baule
notes: Town beach: kiting restricted in summer bathing hours.

name: Lac d'Hourtin-Carcans
notes: Lake: flat water.

name: Lac de Lacanau
notes: Lake: flat water.

name: Bassin d'Arcachon – La Hume
notes: Tidal basin: ride around high tide.

name: Leucate – Les Coussoules / La Franqui
notes: Famous tramontane spot; the tramontane (NW) is offshore here: experts only.

name: Étang de La Palme
notes: Shallow flat-water lagoon; launch on the south-east shore.

name: Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer – Beauduc
notes: Remote beach (track access).

name: Marseille – Pointe Rouge
locate: q:Plage de la Pointe Rouge Marseille

name: Lac de Serre-Ponçon – Boscodon / Crots
notes: Thermal wind from late morning; kiting forbidden near the bridge and in bathing areas.

name: Lac de Monteynard
notes: Famous thermal spot (south wind in the afternoon).

name: Lac du Der – Giffaumont
notes: Kite zone regulated (check the club at Port d'Arrigny); forbidden zone in summer.

name: Sant Pere Pescador
notes: Authorised summer kite zone (piscifactoria area).

name: Barcelona – Nova Mar Bella
locate: q:Platja de la Nova Mar Bella
notes: City beach: kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep; off-season only.

name: Castelldefels
notes: Authorised summer kite zone (online registration required).

name: Torredembarra
notes: Kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep (Catalan coast rule).

name: La Pineda
notes: Kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep (Catalan coast rule).

name: Riumar (Ebro delta)
notes: Year-round (no seasonal ban).

name: El Trabucador (Ebro delta)
notes: Authorised summer kite zone; flat water on the Badia dels Alfacs (west) side.

name: Santa Pola – La Gola
locate: q:Playa de La Gola Santa Pola

name: Mar Menor – Los Narejos
notes: Flat-water lagoon.

name: Mallorca – Son Serra de Marina
locate: q:Platja de Son Serra de Marina

name: El Palmar (Vejer)
locate: q:Playa de El Palmar Vejer de la Frontera

name: Los Caños de Meca
locate: q:Playa de Los Caños de Meca

name: Lagoa de Óbidos
notes: Flat-water lagoon.

name: Lagoa de Albufeira
notes: Flat-water lagoon.

name: Peniche – Baleal
notes: North side of the Baleal isthmus.

name: Fuseta (Ria Formosa)
notes: Lagoon: flat water; tide matters.

name: Lo Stagnone (Marsala)
notes: Flat-water lagoon.

name: Lago di Garda – Campione
notes: Thermal winds: Pelèr (N) in the morning, Ora (S) in the afternoon.

name: Lago di Como – Colico
notes: Thermal Breva (S) in the afternoon.

name: West Wittering
notes: Kiting restricted in the summer season.

name: Rerik – Salzhaff
notes: Flat-water lagoon.

name: Norddeich

name: Schillig
notes: Wadden Sea: ride around high tide.

name: Prasonisi

name: Dakhla – Speed Spot (PK25 camps)
notes: Flat shallow lagoon in front of the PK25 camps (Dakhla Attitude, Dakhla Club); best at low tide.

name: Dakhla – Dune Blanche
notes: Flat water behind the white dune; best at high tide.

name: Dakhla – Oum Labouir (Westpoint)
notes: Atlantic side: waves; wind lighter and gustier in the bay.

name: Dakhla – Lassarga
notes: Lagoon shore by the fishing village near the peninsula tip.

name: Svencelė (Curonian Lagoon)

name: Chałupy (Hel Peninsula)

name: Kuźnica (Hel Peninsula)

name: Jastarnia (Hel Peninsula)
